question: What was the motor claim frequency by state in Q2 2026?

sql:
WITH numerator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
               coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
               c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
        FROM claims c
        JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
        ) pay USING (claim_id)
    )
    SELECT state, count(*) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
      AND product IN ('motor')
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
),
denominator AS (
    WITH source AS (
        SELECT * FROM exposure_monthly
    )
    SELECT state, sum(policies_in_force) AS value
    FROM source
    WHERE month >= DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND month <= DATE '2026-06-30'
      AND product IN ('motor')
    GROUP BY ALL
    ORDER BY ALL
)
SELECT state, 1000 * numerator.value / nullif(denominator.value, 0) AS value
FROM numerator JOIN denominator USING (state)
ORDER BY ALL

report.interpretation: Motor claim frequency, defined as 1000 × claims ÷ policy-months. Claims are counted by loss date from 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (Q2 2026). Results are split by policy state. Exposure is taken from exposure_monthly.
report.answer: In Q2 2026, motor claim frequency per 1,000 policies per month was highest in NSW (7.95) and TAS (7.81). VIC was 7.03 and QLD 6.77. WA was 6.49, SA 6.40 and ACT 5.99. NT was lowest at 4.57. Q2 ended three months before the extract date, so late-reported claims will have little effect. The latest weeks of June may still be slightly understated.
